evidence: No material accounting-reliability or management-integrity issue identified in the supplied 10-K, 10-Q, Q3 8-K or proxy.
Broadcom generates very large positive FCF and is not structurally dependent on new equity/debt funding for operations.
SBC is material, but repurchases are large and outstanding share growth is limited; monitor net dilution rather than gross SBC expense.
Growth is driven by mission-critical custom silicon/networking and infrastructure software rather than subsidies or promotional acquisition.
Revenue growth is currently accompanied by faster operating-income and FCF growth, not collapsing incremental economics.
Current evidence indicates moat broadening in AI custom compute/networking; no persistent moat contraction identified.
Current price requires strong FCF growth, but not the full management AI-revenue bull trajectory; valuation is demanding rather than mathematically dependent on a perfect bull case.
Top five end customers accounted for about 40% of FY2025 revenue; one distributor represented 32% of revenue. AI growth is concentrated among a small number of hyperscalers/frontier-model customers.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Track customer-specific AI revenue concentration, design-win duration, and whether 2027-2028 growth broadens across customers.
